title: 生物风险管理：一张全景图
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/13_MOOC INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT OVERVIEW.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/13_MOOC INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT OVERVIEW/src.py

points.K9: 设施把气溶胶关在里面
points.K11: 逐项评估，再看剩余风险
points.K15: 个人防护是最后一道防线
points.K19: 生物安全员与持续改进

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼前，手里拿着一张卷起的空白地图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a laboratory building holding a rolled-up blank map, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天给大家画一张生物风险管理全景图。
overlay: 生物风险管理：一张全景图

shots.scene: 欣欣展开地图，上面是几个图标：盾牌、锁、循环箭头、手掌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot unrolls the blank map showing only icons: a shield, a padlock, a circle of arrows and an open hand.
shots.narration: 从概念到方法，一次看明白。

shots.scene: 阿杰手套破了个口，站在实验室门口发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a laboratory door looking at a small tear in his glove, worried.
shots.narration: 阿杰的手套破了，他有点慌。

shots.scene: 阿杰小声说话，小研在一旁听
shots.prompt_en: The young male student whispers while the female graduate student listens beside him.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：没出事，就不用说了吧？

shots.scene: 小研摇头，指向墙上的空白报告表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and points to a blank report form on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研说：这正是要报告的事。

shots.scene: 欣欣出现在两人中间，举起地图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot appears between them and holds up the icon map.
shots.narration: 为什么？先从全景图讲起。

shots.scene: 一个大盾牌分成两半，左边绿色、右边蓝色
shots.prompt_en: A large shield split into two halves, green on the left and blue on the right, with a biohazard warning sign in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 管生物风险，有两件事要做。

shots.scene: 两半盾牌合在一起
shots.prompt_en: The two halves of the shield join together into one shield. No people.
shots.narration: 一是生物安全，二是生物安保。

shots.scene: 小研在台前专心操作，样品管不小心碰倒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works carefully at a bench, and a sample tube tips over by accident.
shots.narration: 按规程做实验，也可能出意外。

shots.scene: 管子周围冒出小点，越过一圈虚线
shots.prompt_en: Small dots escape from the tipped tube and cross a dashed containment line. No people.
shots.narration: 防护被突破，病原意外跑出来，

shots.scene: 无恶意的笑脸图标和问号
shots.prompt_en: A neutral face icon with a question mark, no warning signs. No people.
shots.narration: 没人故意，这属于生物安全。

shots.scene: 样品盒被画成一个金色宝箱图标
shots.prompt_en: A sample box drawn as a golden treasure chest icon with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保换个角度看病原：

shots.scene: 宝箱外一只可疑的手伸过来，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A suspicious shadowy hand reaches for the treasure chest and is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 它是资产，可能被人蓄意盯上。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员锁上储存柜
shots.prompt_en: The security officer locks a storage cabinet with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 防丢失、防被盗、防滥用。

shots.scene: 四段箭头组成圆圈
shots.prompt_en: Four arrow segments forming a circle, each with an icon: a pencil, a hand, a magnifier and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 管实验室，靠一个循环：

shots.scene: 圆圈不停转动
shots.prompt_en: The circle of four arrows keeps turning. No people.
shots.narration: 计划、执行、检查、改进，周而复始。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白规程操作，再在记录本上写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student follows a blank procedure sheet at the bench, then writes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 写下怎么做，就照写的做。

shots.scene: 循环圆圈变成三段：放大镜、盾牌、对勾
shots.prompt_en: The circle changes into three arrow segments with a magnifier, a shield and a check mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用到生物风险上，就成了三步：

shots.scene: 欣欣依次指着三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the three icons one by one.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效，简称 AMP。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准一个病毒图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier focuses on a virus icon. No people.
shots.narration: 评估第一步，认清是什么病原。

shots.scene: 打喷嚏的人形图标，周围飘着小点
shots.prompt_en: A sneezing person outline icon with tiny droplets and aerosol dots floating around. No people.
shots.narration: 它怎么传播？会不会形成气溶胶？

shots.scene: 鼻子、嘴、手、皮肤四个途径图标
shots.prompt_en: Four route icons: a nose, a mouth, a hand and a skin patch, with arrows pointing inward. No people.
shots.narration: 从哪里进入人体？

shots.scene: 体温计和病床图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a thermometer and a hospital bed. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会致病，严重到什么程度？

shots.scene: 药瓶和疫苗瓶图标，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A blank medicine bottle and a vaccine vial icon with a question mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 有没有治疗和预防的办法？

shots.scene: 四个台阶，颜色由浅到深，写着 1 到 4
shots.prompt_en: Four steps colored from light to dark, numbered 1 to 4 from left to right. No people.
shots.narration: 国际上把病原分为危险度一到四组，

shots.scene: 第 4 级台阶最高，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The fourth and darkest step is the tallest, with a warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 数字越大，危害越大。

shots.scene: 第 1 级台阶最低最浅，旁边一个小小的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: The first and lightest step is the lowest, with a small calm person outline icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一组对人的危害最低。

shots.scene: 欣欣沿台阶从 1 走到 4
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot walks up the four steps from the lightest to the darkest.
shots.narration: 一组比一组更危险，致死性更高。

shots.scene: 一个培养瓶里的小点越变越多
shots.prompt_en: Dots inside a culture flask multiply and fill the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 病原本身之外，操作也会加码。

shots.scene: 满瓶小点的瓶子倒下，溅出一大片
shots.prompt_en: The full flask tips over and a large splash of dots spreads across the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 培养后数量多了，洒了后果更重。

shots.scene: 离心机图标上方飘出气溶胶小点
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge icon with aerosol dots rising above its lid. No people.
shots.narration: 离心可能产生气溶胶。

shots.scene: DNA 双螺旋图标旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 改造病原，也会带来新的风险。

shots.section_title: 设施把气溶胶关在里面
shots.scene: 实验室图标外是人群和城市图标
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory icon surrounded by people outline icons and a small city skyline. No people.
shots.narration: 病原一旦外泄，伤到人员和公众。
overlay: 设施把气溶胶关在里面

shots.section_title: 设施把气溶胶关在里面
shots.scene: 平面图上气流箭头流向实验室深处
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with arrows of air flowing from the corridor deeper into the laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 高级别实验室，气流只往里走，

shots.section_title: 设施把气溶胶关在里面
shots.scene: 进风口和排风口都有滤网图标
shots.prompt_en: Air supply and exhaust ducts both fitted with filter icons, dots trapped on the exhaust filter. No people.
shots.narration: 进出的空气都经高效过滤。

shots.section_title: 设施把气溶胶关在里面
shots.scene: 欣欣穿着连体防护服、戴送风头罩，站在实验室里指着排风口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a full-body protective suit and a powered air hood inside a containment laboratory, pointing at an exhaust vent.
shots.narration: 这就是设施层面的工程控制。

shots.scene: 天平两端：骰子图标和爆炸碎片图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a dice icon on one side and a broken-glass impact icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 风险看两样：可能性和后果。

shots.scene: 转运箱盖子没扣紧，晃动中渗出液滴
shots.prompt_en: A transport box with an unlatched lid shakes and drips liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 转运不规范，泄漏的可能就大，

shots.scene: 提箱人图标被小点包围
shots.prompt_en: A person outline icon carrying the box is surrounded by small dots. No people.
shots.narration: 后果是转运的人可能被感染。

shots.section_title: 逐项评估，再看剩余风险
shots.scene: 一条流程线上排着取样、培养、离心、废弃几个图标
shots.prompt_en: A process line with icons for sampling, culturing, centrifuging and discarding. No people.
shots.narration: 把要做的操作一项项列出来，
overlay: 逐项评估，再看剩余风险

shots.section_title: 逐项评估，再看剩余风险
shots.scene: 每个图标下面出现一个小仪表
shots.prompt_en: A small gauge appears under each process icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每项单独评估，再合起来看总风险。

shots.section_title: 逐项评估，再看剩余风险
shots.scene: 加上盾牌后，大红条缩成小黄条
shots.prompt_en: A big red bar shrinks to a small yellow bar after shield icons are added. No people.
shots.narration: 措施都用上后，还剩多少风险？

shots.section_title: 逐项评估，再看剩余风险
shots.scene: 老周看着小黄条点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man studies the small yellow bar on a blank chart and nods thoughtfully.
shots.narration: 能接受才开展，不能接受就再改。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一只手，张开五指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one paw with five fingers spread toward the camera.
shots.narration: 减缓风险，用五类控制措施。

shots.scene: 五根手指各对应一个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five fingers of an open hand, each tipped with a different icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一只手的五根手指，正好记住。

shots.scene: 一份空白实验方案被打叉放进抽屉
shots.prompt_en: A blank experiment plan with a red X is placed into a drawer. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，消除：风险太大，就不做。

shots.scene: 强壮的病毒图标换成虚弱的小病毒图标
shots.prompt_en: A strong virus icon is swapped for a pale weakened virus icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，替代：改用减毒的株。

shots.scene: 老李检查实验室的通风和安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects ventilation ducts and a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 第三，工程控制：设施和设备来挡。

shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank procedure binder.
shots.narration: 第四，管理控制：定规程，照着做。

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 欣欣穿连体防护服，双手扶着送风头罩
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a full-body protective suit holds the powered air hood on its head with both paws.
shots.narration: 第五，个人防护，比如这身装备。
overlay: 个人防护是最后一道防线

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 前面几道墙破了，最后一面盾牌挡住小点
shots.prompt_en: Several walls ahead have cracks, but a last shield in front of a person outline icon blocks the dots. No people.
shots.narration: 其他措施失灵时，它是最后一道防线。

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 只有手套、没有安全柜的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of gloved hands working without a cabinet is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 所以不能只靠防护用品。

shots.scene: 五根手指握成拳头
shots.prompt_en: Five fingers close into a fist. No people.
shots.narration: 五类控制要配合，缺一不可。

shots.scene: 实验室门旁贴着空白进出流程图
shots.prompt_en: A blank entry and exit flowchart with icons is posted beside a laboratory door. No people.
shots.narration: 有了设施，还得有进出规程。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白流程图穿戴防护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on protective clothing while following a blank flowchart with icons.
shots.narration: 穿脱防护，也要按规程。

shots.scene: 空白生物安全手册
shots.prompt_en: A blank biosafety manual with a biohazard warning sign on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 这些都写进生物安全手册。

shots.scene: 王老师拿空白检查表站在实验台旁
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands beside a lab bench with a blank checklist, watching the female graduate student work.
shots.narration: 第三步：绩效评估。

shots.scene: 检查表上一个步骤旁出现红圈
shots.prompt_en: One step on the blank checklist gets a red circle. No people.
shots.narration: 到实验台旁看，哪步繁琐、哪步有险。

shots.scene: 更衣间手套架上只剩大号或小号
shots.prompt_en: A changing room glove shelf with only very large and very small glove boxes, the middle slot empty. No people.
shots.narration: 比如更衣间没有合适的手套，

shots.scene: 偏小的手套被撑破
shots.prompt_en: An undersized glove stretched on a hand tears open. No people.
shots.narration: 戴了小号，进去后破了。

shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师报告，王老师记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the safety administrator, who writes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 阿杰如实报告了。

shots.scene: 冰山图标：水面上一小块，水面下一大块
shots.prompt_en: An iceberg icon with a small tip above water and a large mass below. No people.
shots.narration: 没出事的险情，是事故的前兆。

shots.section_title: 生物安全员与持续改进
shots.scene: 王老师观察人员操作，在本子上记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator quietly observes people working and takes notes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 生物安全员观察大家怎么做，
overlay: 生物安全员与持续改进

shots.section_title: 生物安全员与持续改进
shots.scene: 放大镜指向空手套架
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier points at the empty middle slot of the glove shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 找出问题的根源。

shots.section_title: 生物安全员与持续改进
shots.scene: 空白规程被修改，循环箭头回到起点
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure sheet gets a new line added, and a circular arrow returns to the start. No people.
shots.narration: 改进规程，再回到评估，循环向前。

shots.scene: 一圈人物：王老师、老李、老周、小研、阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator, the facility engineer, the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student stand in a circle.
shots.narration: 管理人员、设施管理、实验人员，

shots.scene: 地球图标外一圈盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon surrounded by a ring of shields. No people.
shots.narration: 学会这些，为应对疫情做准备。

shots.scene: 老李看着空白新实验室图纸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer studies a blank floor plan of a new laboratory with airflow arrows.
shots.narration: 建新实验室时，也用得上。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在全景图前，盾牌两半合一
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands before the icon map showing the joined two-half shield.
shots.narration: 防意外，也防滥用。

shots.scene: 三段循环和五指手掌
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the three-step circle and the open hand with five fingers. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效；五类控制齐配合。

shots.scene: 冰山图标和循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an iceberg and a circular arrow returning to the start. No people.
shots.narration: 险情要报，规程要改进。

shots.scene: 阿杰把空白报告表交给王老师，两人点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a blank report form to the safety administrator, and both nod.
shots.narration: 阿杰的手套破了，就该这样报。

shots.scene: 欣欣卷起全景图，挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot rolls up the icon map and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 全景图记心里，下次见！
